description: SPEC §6.7 E8 on Twin Roots, in round 6 (the storm at ×1.4): both Heartcaps stand at 100, the general's of 3000, and each side takes a lane on the first tick. Your Rootbreakers deal 75 × 18 × 1.4 = 1890, capped at 750 (25% of the general's 3000); its Capguards deal 75 × 6 × 1.4 = 630. Both Heartcaps reach 0 in the same round, so the general wins by Rout, though you won the round. Merging is off.
